basis: Blue Apron’s August 3 results release was the earliest qualifying disclosure found. For the three months ended June 30, consolidated GAAP net revenue fell from $131,040,000 in 2020 to $124,010,000 in 2021, a 5.36% decline. Actual revenue was $478,000 below the $124,488,000 cutoff. The May outlook straddled that cutoff, and the intervening disclosure search found no narrower public forecast.

coverage.detail: February 18, preceding earnings cycle. The Q4 2020 release projected $125 million to $129 million for Q1 2021 and double-digit net revenue growth for full-year 2021. Neither established a Q2 revenue ceiling.
The February 18 earnings-call presentation likewise confined its forward revenue outlook to Q1 and full-year 2021.

May 6, Q1 earnings release. Management explicitly guided Q2 net revenue to approximately $122 million to $126 million. The high end exceeded the cutoff by $1,512,000 and implied only a 3.85% decline. The accompanying description of a slight decline supplied no tighter bound.
May 6 earnings-call presentation. The deck included a Q2 outlook. The search of the presentation and contemporary accounts of management’s call found no narrower Q2 net revenue range.
June 15 offering announcement, furnished June 17. Blue Apron announced a proposed sale of Class A shares and gave no Q2 sales estimate.
June 16 pricing announcement, also furnished June 17. The figures concerned the share offering and its proceeds. The announcement supplied no revised Q2 revenue guidance.
July 13 issuer notice distributed by Business Wire. Blue Apron scheduled the August 3 premarket release and management call without disclosing preliminary revenue.

August 3 actuals. The consolidated statements of operations give Q2 net revenue of 124,010 versus 131,040 in thousands of dollars. Both figures use the reported consolidated perimeter. The 2021 figure includes approximately $2 million from recovery of customer credits.
Item 2.02 independently confirms the announcement date, the June 30 quarter end, and the identity of Exhibit 99.1 as the public results release.

publication_date_evidence: The issuer’s Exhibit 99.1 is datelined August 3, 2021. Item 2.02 of the accompanying Form 8-K explicitly says Blue Apron announced the June-quarter results on August 3, 2021.
